clue.text: Place of retreat from unorthodox Tory view, or one pulling teeth

definitions.meaning: a secluded refuge cut off from the practical world

indicators.note: unorthodox means not following the usual pattern, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dissident Tory seeks somewhere to retreat to, or else a dentist at work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unorthodox' rearranges TORY VIEW OR; 'one pulling teeth' is a second, cryptic definition: a TOWER (one who tows) of IVORY (teeth).
explanation.definitionFit: An ivory tower is an idiom for a secluded refuge from practical realities, often academic.

clue.text: For popular quartet a 5th is admitted

parts.note: something popular is in, in fashion

explanation.surface: A popular foursome lets in a fifth member.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For' is the definition, as in 'I'm for it': supporting.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in favour of something means supporting it, which is what 'for' means in a vote.

clue.text: Lao Tse has new formula from Bones

explanation.walkthrough: Lao Tse is the Chinese sage usually credited with the Tao Te Ching.
explanation.definitionFit: Osteal is the anatomical adjective for bony tissue, relating to the skeleton.

clue.text: See 23
Much regaled at a party!

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an everyday synonym for a lot or plenty, a large quantity.

clue.text: "Long to pursue runner", said rapper to wit

parts.note: a ski is a runner, and L (long, as on clothing labels) pursues it, coming after

explanation.definitionFit: Scilicet is a Latin adverb meaning namely or that is to say, abbreviated sc.

clue.text: Blind follower's taken out in Rome?

indicators.note: taken out as in taken apart, so these letters are rearranged

clue.text: Sticks up spruce

parts.note: gums means sticks, as with glue

explanation.walkthrough: 'spruce' looks like the tree; it is the adjective meaning neat, an old sense of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Chambers gives smart or neat as an older sense of the word, now usually self-satisfied.

clue.text: It's applied in hilarious fashion, so singly formed?

definitions.text: It's applied in hilarious fashion, so singly formed?

parts.words: It's applied in hilarious fashion, so singly formed?
parts.note: a skin product applied to the face; make the word for a pale dairy topping disappear from screamingly (hilariously) and only singly remains

explanation.surface: Something is put on in a comical way and so made one at a time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in hilarious fashion' is SCREAMINGLY; when CREAM vanishes from it, SINGLY is what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: Vanishing cream is a cosmetic that is rubbed into the skin until it disappears from view.

clue.text: See 9
Bum, near broke, owing money?

indicators.note: broke means broken up, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: being in the red means owing money

explanation.surface: A layabout, nearly bankrupt, is in debt.

clue.text: Bearded giant maybe sides with the family divided

the sides are right and left, R and L

clue.text: Fish cause trouble for surfers

definitions.meaning: to fish by trailing a baited line behind a boat
to post provocative messages to upset people browsing online

explanation.surface: Fish cause trouble for surfers.
explanation.definitionFit: One verb means both trailing a line for fish and stirring up online forum users.

clue.text: Profane Croat finds new way to get through pass dangerously

indicators.note: one piece gets through the other, so the rearranged letters sit inside

parts.note: to cuss is to swear, to be profane

indicators.note: a new way of arranging these letters is needed

explanation.walkthrough: 'pass' looks like a mountain pass; it is overtaking on the road.
explanation.definitionFit: Overtaking another vehicle by swerving in front of it is a dangerous form of overtaking.

clue.text: A little home cooking?

parts.note: a small country dwelling plus a dish being baked: minced meat under mash

explanation.surface: A spot of home cooking?
explanation.definitionFit: A baked dish of minced meat topped with mashed potato, named as if a small house were the dish.

clue.text: Recommend awaiting hospital bed?

parts.note: set for means ready and waiting for
a ward is where hospital beds are

explanation.surface: A patient is waiting for a bed on the ward.
explanation.definitionFit: To put forward or propose a plan or person, to present for approval.

clue.text: As distilled from the Weatherfield Gazette's gossip column?

definitions.text: As distilled from the Weatherfield Gazette's gossip column?

parts.words: As distilled from the Weatherfield Gazette's gossip column?

explanation.surface: Something extracted from a soap opera's local paper gossip page.
explanation.walkthrough: Weatherfield is the fictional town of Coronation Street, the long-running British TV soap.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for current rumour or gossip, what people are saying.

clue.text: Great God — preposterous palimony!

clue.text: With mounting amount of work getting in in good time for tea

parts.note: the erg is a unit of work

explanation.surface: With a growing workload, someone gets in early in time for tea.
explanation.definitionFit: Earl Grey is a black tea flavoured with bergamot.

clue.text: Cocktail of whisky is truly an incendiary

indicators.note: something incendiary explodes, so the letters are blown apart

explanation.surface: A whisky cocktail is genuinely a firebomb.

clue.text: Keep horses under control

definitions.meaning: to house horses in a building

explanation.surface: Keep horses under control.
explanation.definitionFit: One word is both housing for horses and a description of something steady and secure.

clue.text: This petrol will make consignment

explanation.definitionFit: Goods carried by a ship or plane form a consignment, its load of freight.

clue.text: Red mark checker uses to ring what's not right?

left, L, is not right

clue.text: Design intermediate base

explanation.surface: An intermediate design for a base.

clue.text: Healthy state dresses as German city
